303	    def _denormalise_bm_inc(self, x: _BrownianReturn) -> _BrownianReturn:
304	        # Rescaling back from [0, 1] to the original interval [t0, t1].
305	        interval_len = self.t1 - self.t0  # can be any dtype
306	        sqrt_len = jnp.sqrt(interval_len)
307	
308	        def mult(z):
309	            dtype = jnp.result_type(z)
310	            return jnp.astype(interval_len, dtype) * z
311	
312	        def sqrt_mult(z):
313	            # need to cast to dtype of each leaf in PyTree
314	            dtype = jnp.result_type(z)
315	            return jnp.astype(sqrt_len, dtype) * z
316	
317	        def is_dt(z):
318	            return z is x.dt
319	
320	        dt, other = eqx.partition(x, is_dt)
321	        dt_normalized = jtu.tree_map(mult, dt)
322	        other_normalized = jtu.tree_map(sqrt_mult, other)
323	        return eqx.combine(dt_normalized, other_normalized)
